name: TetSplat Pre-processing: Mesh Partitioning
aliases: Partitioning the Input Mesh into the Shell and the Solid
definition: The method partitions a large unstructured tetrahedral mesh into two distinct topological parts: the 'Shell' (non-convex boundary) and the 'Solid' (internal fragments). This separation allows the Shell to be rendered as a standard opaque surface mesh with vertex normals, while the Solid is rendered using normals derived from the CSG probe, as interior tetrahedra are only visible at the intersection surface.
summary: TetSplat Mesh Partitioning separates a tetrahedral mesh into a Shell and Solid to apply distinct shading strategies, resolving shading discontinuities at the CSG probe interface.
